name: Tomato Juice
siboNotes: Pure tomato juice is well-tolerated in SIBO protocols. Check labels to avoid added onion or garlic powder which are high FODMAP.
preparationTips: Choose 100% tomato juice without added high FODMAP ingredients
Check labels for onion powder, garlic powder, or high fructose corn syrup
Fresh-squeezed tomato juice is ideal for sensitive individuals
Dilute with water if experiencing any digestive sensitivity
nutritionalHighlights: High in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant
Good source of vitamin C and potassium
Low in calories and naturally fat-free
